name: Finessekid
description: '''Glodi Mampuli''' (born October 2001), known professionally as '''Finessekid''' or simply '''FK,''' is an English rapper from [[Lambeth|Lambeth, South London]]. He is known for his unorthodox approach to [[UK rap|UK Rap]], blending elements of [[Drill music|drill]], [[Trap music|trap]], [[Rage (music genre)|rage]] and [[Club music|club]].
